input.summary: Add a Company-only convenience termination right on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 6(a) only lets us walk when no Statement of Work is outstanding, so we have no convenience right during an active engagement. We add a Company-only right to terminate the Agreement or any Statement of Work on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees; Contractor remains barred from convenience termination while a Statement of Work is outstanding. We can discuss 60-90 days' notice as a fallback.

ops.text: In addition, Company may terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience upon thirty (30) days' advance written notice to Contractor, in which case Contractor shall refund to Company, pro rata, any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of such termination.
